time_since_dose_or_application: peak and trough relative to injections; exact offsets not specified
short_source_excerpt: ensure levels remain in the normal male range
faithful_paraphrase: For transgender male adolescents after completed pubertal induction and adults using testosterone enanthate or cypionate injections, the guideline states that peak and trough testosterone levels should remain within the normal male range.
required_context: This is the analytically distinct range component of the same alternative clause whose specimen-timing component is REC0014. REC0011 represents the broader Item 2 normal-physiologic-male-range instruction without Item 2a route, formulation, or peak/trough context. The corrected 400–700 ng/dL target in REC0013 applies only to the separate mid-cycle instruction. The pre-Table-14 “key issues” sentence is context-only. Table 14 is adapted from references 154 and 159, but item-level provenance remains unresolved.
unknowns: The testosterone fraction, assay, exact peak and trough collection offsets, numerical normal-male-range boundaries, and intramuscular versus subcutaneous applicability are not specified. The table-level adaptation note does not establish item-level provenance.
claims_not_supported: This instruction does not establish a numerical peak/trough target, does not import the 400–700 ng/dL mid-cycle interval, does not make peak, trough, and mid-cycle results interchangeable, and does not support other formulations or routes.
